description: This file defines the SocketConnectionListenerFactory class, which implements IConnectionListenerFactory to create and bind socket connection listeners using specified options, trace logging, and schedulers within the Orleans networking shared namespace.

classes.name: SocketConnectionListenerFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating and binding socket connection listeners with specified options, logging, and scheduling.

methods.name: SocketConnectionListenerFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the factory with logger factory, socket connection options, and schedulers.

methods.name: BindAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates and binds a socket connection listener to the specified endpoint.
